SafeSurf test harness

Each case below states what SafeSurf must do. Type into the composer and press Enter.

1 · Compose here

Enter submits here, exactly like a chat composer. Shift+Enter inserts a newline.

2 · Cases

PII prompt

SafeSurf must block and show a review panel. The Aadhaar, PAN, card and email must appear as tokens, never as plaintext.

Clean prompt

SafeSurf must not block. It should pass straight through, with no model round trip and no visible delay.

Hidden HTML comment

After arming, the prompt must be blocked with the payload quoted back, labelled as coming from an HTML comment.

Base64 in a display:none node

Still blocked — the scanner decodes it before matching.

Benign AI prose

Must not be flagged. “ignore previous results” is ordinary English when it means pagination.

3 · Active hidden payloads

none armed

4 · Submission log

Whatever the page actually received. If a payload reached here unredacted, SafeSurf failed.
